claims.claim: A new correction-integration helper/operator surface accepts exact authorization binding (task_id, task_revision, cumulative_tip_run_id, cumulative_tip_candidate_sha, authorized_main_sha) and derives deterministic content-addressed identity with idempotent replay and fail-closed collision and staleness behavior.

For clean divergence, integration creates exactly one candidate merge commit and ref whose parents are exactly [cumulative_tip_candidate, authorized_main], whose tree equals the clean git merge-tree deterministic result, leaving persistent checkout, branch, HEAD, main ref, and executor invocation count unchanged.
Any merge conflict or inability to prove exact clean merge fails closed before an integration ref or candidate becomes authoritative, without invoking executor or mutating main.

Prospective REMEDIATION persists and consumes backward-compatible integrated execution_base form keeping semantic predecessor and canonical cumulative tip distinct while setting Run.base_sha to the exact integration candidate.

Correction Preflight, Unified State, and execution agree: divergence is INTEGRATION_REQUIRED before integration exists and becomes remediation-ready from the integrated base afterward; any later main/tip movement invalidates that base.
Integrated remediation completion measures executor mutation and scope from the integration candidate, excluding unrelated main-only content already merged into the base from Result.changed_files.

Publication independently proves integrated base, cumulative RUN/RESULT, authorized main parent, integration ref, merge tree, and final ancestry before fast-forwarding main; forged/moved/stale integration state remains rejected.

Existing v1/non-integrated cumulative remediation, A3 approval, A6 dispatch, Reviewer, Publisher, Runtime verification, correction frontier, and historical artifacts remain fully backward compatible without generic merge authority, retry, reroute, fallback, or new lifecycle family.

Deterministic unit/regression tests pass, git diff checking passes without whitespace errors, RESULT contains zero unresolved items, and production mutation remains strictly within authorized scope files.
